24. Read the passage and answer the question.
Man is the architect of his own life. If he makes proper division of his time and does his duties accordingly, he is sure to prosper in life. But if he does otherwise, he is sure to repent when it is too late. Our life is nothing but the sum total of hours, days and years. Youth is the golden season of life. In youth mind is soft and can be moulded in any form we like. If we waste the precious time of our youth, we shall have to suffer afterwards. Youth is called the seed time of life. How is life defined here?
options: Life is defined as doing our duties in time.
Life is defined as enjoying youth.
Life is defined as the sum total of hours, days and years.
Life is defined as childhood, youth and old age.
Life is not a bed of roses.

questions.question:
25. Read the passage and answer the question.
Man is the architect of his own life. If he makes proper division of his time and does his duties accordingly, he is sure to prosper in life. But if he does otherwise, he is sure to repent when it is too late. Our life is nothing but the sum total of hours, days and years. Youth is the golden season of life. In youth mind is soft and can be moulded in any form we like. If we waste the precious time of our youth, we shall have to suffer afterwards. Youth is called the seed time of life. If we sow good seeds in our life, we shall reap good harvest when we grow up to manhood.
Why is youth regarded as the golden season of life?
options: Because youth is the mid age of life.
Because during this time our mind is soft and it can be moulded in any form we like.
Because youth is the time to prosper in life.
Because youth is the vital time to prosper in life.
Because youth is the time to sow seeds in our life.
